info.name: Registry Dashboard APIs (Farmer, Crop, Livestock)
info.description:
Read-only aggregate chart APIs of the Farmer, Crop Sown and Livestock registries (GET <base>/api/v1/charts/<chartId> returns a JSON array of rows).

One collection, many environments: pick an environment (New Dev, Staging, Local) and everything resolves from variables. Nothing is hardcoded and no credentials are stored in the collection.

Auth: when the environment sets keycloakTokenUrl, clientId and clientSecret, the collection pre-request script gets a client-credentials token (cached until it expires) and sends it as Authorization: Bearer. The client needs the role charts:read on each API's client (farmer/cropsown/livestock-registry-dashboard-api). Leave clientId empty for a service running with auth off (local). /health needs no token.

Filters (optional, empty means none; combined with AND): region, zone, woreda, kebele (codes, bare or level id), farmingType, recordState. Set them in the environment or collection variables.

Categorical values are codes (FEMALE, UNDER_25, ...). Rows are aggregates only.

request.description: Headline totals: farmers, gender split, land, owned land, farmer IDs.

exec: // Client-credentials token from Keycloak, cached until shortly before it expires.
if (pm.collectionVariables.get('_token') && Date.now() < exp - 15000) { pm.request.headers.upsert({key:'Authorization', value:'Bearer ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('_token')}); return; }

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.get('keycloakTokenUrl'), method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body: {mode:'urlencoded', urlencoded:[{key:'grant_type',value:'client_credentials'},{key:'client_id',value:clientId},{key:'client_secret',value:pm.variables.get('clientSecret')}]}}, (err, res) => {
if (err || res.code !== 200) { throw new Error('Keycloak token request failed: ' + (err || res.code)); }
